tasks.label: Start PostgreSQL (Docker)
args: $names = docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'Docker is not running. Open Docker Desktop and try again.'; exit 1 }; if ($names -contains 'relief-pg') { docker start relief-pg | Out-Null } else { Write-Host 'Creating PostgreSQL container (first time downloads it)...'; docker run -d --name relief-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -p 5432:5432 postgres:16 | Out-Null }; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60; $i++) { docker exec relief-pg pg_isready -U postgres -h localhost *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host 'PostgreSQL is ready.'; exit 0 }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; Write-Host 'PostgreSQL did not start in time.'; exit 1
